# RollingNumber

A number whose digits roll like an odometer when it changes; the base for every count and total in the kit.

`IK.RollingNumber` · Primitives

## Use

```jsx
<IK.RollingNumber value={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="IK.RollingNumber" value="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (RollingNumberProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` * | `number` |  |
| `format` | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions \| ((n: number) => string)` |  |
| `locale` | `string` |  |
| `prefix` | `string` |  |
| `suffix` | `string` |  |
| `live` | `boolean` | Announce changes to screen readers (polite). Default false. |
| `animateOnMount` | `boolean` | Roll up from zero on first render. Default true. |
